scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const cp = require('child_process'); if (fs.existsSync('frontend/package.json')) { cp.execSync('npm --prefix frontend run build', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } else { cp.execSync('npx next build', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
scripts.start: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const cp = require('child_process'); if (fs.existsSync('frontend/package.json')) { cp.execSync('npm --prefix frontend run start', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } else { cp.execSync('npx next start', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
scripts.dev: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const cp = require('child_process'); if (fs.existsSync('frontend/package.json')) { cp.execSync('npm --prefix frontend run dev', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } else { cp.execSync('npx next dev', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }"
